text: Code 0 is not applicable for this chapter.
Ocular adnexal lymphomas (OAL) originate in conjunctiva, eyelids, lacrimal gland, lacrimal drainage apparatus, and other orbital tissues surrounding the eye.
This chapter should not be used for secondary lymphomatous involvement of ocular adnexa or for intraocular lymphomas.
If there is peripheral blood or bone marrow involvement, code 7.
The preferred histology terms in this schema are based on the 2024 WHO Classification of Tumours, Haematolymphoid Tumours, 5th edition.

codes.9663: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis, NOS (NSCHL)
codes.9690: Follicular lymphoma (FL), NOS (except C700-C729, C751-C753 for 1/1/2023+)
codes.9699: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)
codes.9705: Nodal T follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type
codes.9715: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-negative (ALK-ALCL) (2021+ only)
codes.9718: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma (C-ALCL)
codes.9719: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma (ENKTL) (except C700-C729, C751-C753 for 1/1/2023+)
codes.9725: Hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoma (2018-2020 only, nonreportable as of 2021)
codes.9726: Primary cutaneous gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma (PCGD-TCL) (2018-2020 only, see code 9687/3 for 2021+)
codes.9826: Burkitt cell leukemia (2018-2020 only, see code 9687/3 for 2021+)

SUMMARY STAGE

1 Localized only (localized, NOS)

- Lymphoma involving the conjunctiva alone WITHOUT or UNKNOWN eyelid or orbital involvement

- Lymphoma with orbital involvement WITH or WITHOUT conjunctival involvement
- Lymphoma with preseptal eyelid involvement WITH or WITHOUT orbital or conjunctival involvement

2 Regional by direct extension only

- Orbital adnexal lymphoma AND extraorbital lymphoma extending beyond the orbit to adjacent structures: Bone; Brain; Maxillofacial sinuses

3 Regional lymph node(s) involved only

- Cervical
- Parotid
- Preauricular
- Regions draining the ocular adnexal structures
- Submandibular
- Regional lymph node(s), NOS

- Lymph node(s), NOS

4 Regional by BOTH direct extension AND regional lymph node(s) involved

Codes (2) + (3)

7 Distant site(s)/lymph node(s) involved

- Distant sites

- Non-contiguous involvement of other extranodal sites including, but not limited to: Breast; Gastrointestinal tract; Kidney; Liver; Lung; Parotid gland; Salivary gland; Spleen; Submandibular gland

- Distant lymph node(s), NOS

- Diffuse OR disseminated involvement of peripheral and central lymph node regions
- Mediastinum

- Distant metastasis, NOS

- Blood/peripheral blood
- Bone marrow
- Distant metastasis WITH or WITHOUT distant lymph node(s)

9 Unknown if extension or metastasis

codes.1: Localized only (localized, NOS): Lymphoma involving the conjunctiva alone WITHOUT or UNKNOWN eyelid or orbital involvement; Lymphoma with orbital involvement WITH or WITHOUT conjunctival involvement; Lymphoma with preseptal eyelid involvement WITH or WITHOUT orbital or conjunctival involvement
codes.2: Regional by direct extension only: Orbital adnexal lymphoma AND extraorbital lymphoma extending beyond the orbit to adjacent structures: Bone; Brain; Maxillofacial sinuses
codes.3: Regional lymph node(s) involved only: Cervical; Parotid; Preauricular; Regions draining the ocular adnexal structures; Submandibular; Regional lymph node(s), NOS; Lymph node(s), NOS
codes.4: Regional by BOTH direct extension AND regional lymph node(s) involved: Codes (2) + (3)
codes.7: Distant site(s)/lymph node(s) involved: Distant sites; Non-contiguous involvement of other extranodal sites including, but not limited to Breast, Gastrointestinal tract, Kidney, Liver, Lung, Parotid gland, Salivary gland, Spleen, Submandibular gland; Distant lymph node(s), NOS; Diffuse OR disseminated involvement of peripheral and central lymph node regions; Mediastinum; Distant metastasis, NOS; Blood/peripheral blood; Bone marrow; Distant metastasis WITH or WITHOUT distant lymph node(s)
